blind_pre_result.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

closed_loop_design.description: For the current human-in-the-loop design cycle after prior experiments are known.

literature_only_sanity.description: Ablation profile used to test whether literature/database priors alone favor resin-modified formulation families.

hard_rule: A blind-pre-result run must never expose the target validation formulation identity, follow-up hold measurements, adjudication labels, or text derived from those outcomes.
